noveltyJustification: Completes the external runtime link surface; separates 24 links that need no change (agent mirrors into .claude/agents) from 72 that need the .opencode -> .skilled segment swap; finds no generator for the Pi extension bridges.
answeredQuestions: Map A external runtime sections complete (cursor, devin, hermes, pi)

ruledOut.approach: Apply a blanket .opencode -> .skilled sed to every runtime symlink
ruledOut.reason: 24 Cursor/Devin agent mirrors point at .claude/agents and would be corrupted

keyFindings.finding: 24 agent mirrors target .claude/agents (unchanged by the move); 51 command mirrors and 39 hook mirrors are generator-owned and need the segment swap.
17 .pi/extensions symlinks are hand-made bridges that Pi loads by path; no generator creates them, only sync-hook-registrations.cjs verifies them.
Five whole-directory links (hermes/agents, pi/skills, four manual-testing-playbook links) carry whole surfaces with one retarget each.
